title: elliotglazer/nf-not-wpp
summary: A Lean 4 proof that standard first-order New Foundations (NF), axiomatized by extensionality and the full stratified-comprehension schema, syntactically derives the negation of the Weak Partition Principle (WPP). The translated Metamath proof enters through eleven literal Hailperin sentences, which are used internally as a finite-basis bridge and are proved deductively equivalent to standard NF.
